notes.title: Shrimp Keeping Simulator 2.0 is here!
notes.content: [h1]Shrimp Keeping Simulator 2.0[/h1][p]I realize this game was pretty low effort on release. So I did some stuff to make it more fun and have more content![/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][list][*][p]Color breeding system[/p][list][*][p]Breed your shrimp to get unique colors[/p][/*][*][p]Changed selling systems to make it work with the new features[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]More stuff to place[/p][list][*][p]Driftwood[/p][/*][*][p]Floaters[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Temperature system[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game breaking bug related to food loading[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481013/a06e6e849e2a9d813871ff4b4d068b73a589710b.png"][/img][/p][h1]Let me know if you have more ideas[/h1]
